meta.title: With team filtering switched off, every purchase user is listed
gaps: Open the Assign dialog for the selected PR-2 item and inspect the complete Search a user list.
Verify that all purchase users are listed, including Food Buyer and Fruits Buyer, with no category filtering.
Verify the prerequisite tenant setting that PR team filtering is switched off.
